PNL-QL-121.template: A dealer claims to sell at cost price ₹{costPricePerTrueQuantity} for {trueQuantity} units, but gives only {deliveredQuantity} units. Find the actual profit percentage.

PNL-QL-124.template: Goods cost ₹{costPricePerTrueQuantity} per {trueQuantity} units. A seller declares a {declaredRatePercent}% {declaredDirection} but delivers only {deliveredQuantity} units. Find the actual profit or loss percentage.

He later charges ₹{sellingPricePerNominalQuantity} for each nominal quantity while delivering only {deliveredQuantity} units. Find his actual profit percentage.
